messages:
alex_chen: Heads-up — planning a rack redistribution next Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC to free 8 A100s for the eu-west1 demo pool. Need a short maintenance window on staging and a temporary quota bump with the cloud account. Vendor handoff required.
priya_k: Rough numbers? which racks, serials, and expected cost delta?
alex_chen: Moving 2 full 1U racks (rack-7 and rack-9). That yields 8x A100 (40GB) total. Staging will keep 4 nodes for smoke. Cost-wise, short-term spot blend -> +~$1.1k/week while demo runs.
samuel_r: Do we need infra changes (terraform) or just physical relocation + routing updates? If TF, ping me and I can review tonight.
alex_chen: Mostly physical + k8s node labels / taints toggle. One small TF: update node-pool counts for eu-west1-demo (PR coming). Will run drain/cordon via a script.
priya_k: Can you paste the drain script? want to sanity-check pod disruption budgets.
alex_chen: Here's the plan snippet we will run from our ops bastion:

```bash
# cordon + drain with grace
kubectl cordon node-${NODE}
kubectl drain node-${NODE} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

We'll stagger 1 node at a time, 10m gap.
northstar_ops: @alex_chen NorthStar confirms we can hold rack-9 for transfer. We need a 48h lead to schedule movers for physical relocation, but we can provide kitted transport on Tue. Serial prefixes: NS-AX7*, NS-AX9* — sharing full manifest via secure link. ETA on manifest: 30m.
priya_k: Good — PDBs look OK for demo namespaces, but app-queue needs a fallback test. Sam can we run a quick failover smoke?
samuel_r: I can run failover test Wed 22:00 UTC and validate queue replay. Will need a brief PR for a test flag (non-prod only).
alex_chen: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/482 — includes node_pool count and post-move taint rules. @samuel_r please review.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: maintenance-1718204321. Notifying oncall and creating a 15-min pre-check at 02:30 UTC.
priya_k: Quota bump — cloud console shows eu-west1 GPU quota at 12, requested 20. @alex_chen can you submit the support ticket with justification (demo + env isolation)?
alex_chen: Done — support ticket #CN-98321 opened with request to raise A100 quota to 24 in eu-west1 for 72 hours. Link in ticket: https://cloud.support/tickets/CN-98321.
northstar_ops: Manifest link: https://northstar.secure/manifest/NS-move-1718204321 (shared). We'll also stage packing lists Tue 00:00 UTC.
samuel_r: Quick note on rollback: if any node fails post-move we'll re-label and route back to staging pool; script includes `--skip` flag to abort after current node completes.
priya_k: Cost owner FYI: @finance please expect a temporary spot uplift ~ $1k-1.5k/wk for the demo.
infra-bot: Oncall notified: @oncall-eng assigned.
alex_chen: Thanks — folks, please react with :thumbsup: when you ack the schedule. I'll post a final checklist 12h before.
priya_k: :thumbsup:
samuel_r: :thumbsup:
northstar_ops: :thumbsup:
alex_chen: Closing the loop — will run the pre-check 02:30 UTC, operations start 03:00 UTC. If anything changes I’ll update in this thread.
